title: Incomelec — claimed by thegentlemen
description: CO · Manufacturing · incomelec.com Incomelec is a Colombian company founded in 2006 in Bogota, the Latin American leader in pedestrian, vehicle and passenger access control including turnstiles and automated barriers. With 52 employees and operations in 14 countries, it has installed equipment in over 20 airports, 90 parking facilities and 250 buildings, handling more than 85 percent of Colombia's toll booth systems.
